feedback.delta: Advance OPEN candidate to CC-RC1.7 TCQS: collection kind participates in semantic identity, legal rewrites, casts and query lowering; retain MRSC multi-rail and triple/multi-axis receipts.

C7 packed runtime ABI should carry a compact collection/type ID and never infer SET/ORDERED/MULTISET/WEIGHTED semantics from wire layout or backend defaults. Packed-ABI performance remains unresolved.
MOSAIC semantic identity must include typed collection/cardinality semantics. Query rewrites that alter duplicate/order/weight behavior must change selection_plan_hash.

Unified ClayCode Query IR must declare result_collection_type, duplicate/order/weight policy and preserve them through exact/relational/graph/vector/FTS/activation lowerings. Type-erased lowering is experimentally unsafe.
Declare collection algebra per relation/Assembly field: role tuples and ranked candidates must not be universally normalized as sets; multiplicity/weight/order semantics require explicit types.
Candidate membership SET semantics, competition/ranking ORDERED or WEIGHTED semantics and WorkspaceEpisode order are distinct causal structures; interventions must pin the declared collection type.
Equality/firebreak operations must compare collection type as part of semantic identity. Cross-kind casts require explicit loss/policy receipts.
Recurrence/macrostate identity must preregister whether permutation, multiplicity and weight changes are semantically equivalent; do not silently normalize ORDERED/MULTISET structures to sets.
